name: chatbotx
description: Operate a ChatbotX omnichannel chatbot workspace from your AI agent: contacts, conversations, flows, broadcasts, sequences, pipelines, and analytics.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your ChatbotX workspace to look up contacts and conversations, review flows, broadcasts, sequences, and analytics, and carry out a small set of approved actions such as sending a message, tagging a contact, assigning a conversation, or moving a pipeline item. You sign in with ChatbotX and choose the workspace on the consent screen.
defaultPrompt: Show new contact counts per day for the last 7 days
List unassigned conversations and summarize them
Which broadcasts ran recently and how did they do?
